question: Welche Regierungsebene bildet den unteren Teil des gestapelten Balkendiagramms im linken Panel?
question_english: Which level of government forms the bottom part of the stacked bar chart in the left panel?
model_answer: The lower portion of the stacked bar chart in the left panel is formed by "Gemeinden" (municipalities). This is indicated by the green shading at the base of each bar, as shown in the legend. The chart depicts the percentage of gross domestic product (BIP) contributed by different levels of government.
